items.title: Bond yield worries persist as oil edges higher: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Stocks fell on Monday as long-dated bond yields continued to climb amid surging oil prices, raising concerns that the Federal Reserve will need to hike rates at its policy meeting next week.

items.title: Kioxia Dismisses SK Hynix Tie-Up, Vows to Ease Chip Price Rises
items.summary: Kioxia Holdings Corp.’s top executive brushed aside the likelihood of deeper ties with rival and stakeholder SK Hynix Inc., while pledging to keep surging memory prices at bay to avoid denting long-term AI demand.

items.title: Can SanDisk Stock Keep Climbing When It Cannot Make Enough To Sell?
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) finished fiscal 2026 with $20.2 billion in revenue, and its stock has returned roughly 2,700% over the past twelve months, while the shares still sit about 25% below their 52-week high. Anyone buying now is asking one question. What powers the next leg, when the company has already said it can only make so many more bits.

items.title: Micron and Sandisk Soar as Goldman Sees New Memory Stock Rally
items.summary: Micron and Sandisk Surge as Goldman Spots Powerful Shift in Memory Stocks

items.title: Goldman Says the Worst May Be Over for Micron and SanDisk
items.summary: Memory stocks are rallying again as AI demand strengthens and Goldman sees early signs that months of weakness may be ending.

items.title: Sandisk Jumps Nearly 3.5% as S&P 100 Promotion Extends Its AI Run
items.summary: The index upgrade adds another buyer base after AI storage demand transformed Sandisk's earnings.

items.title: SanDisk Stock Has Soared More Than 500% in 2026. Can the Rally Possibly Continue?
items.summary: SanDisk has turned in one of the most explosive stock runs of 2026, but Wall Street and one closely watched model are now pointing in opposite directions, and the gap between them could define where this trade goes next.

items.title: Can Western Digital's Strong FCF Sustain Buybacks and Dividends?
items.summary: WDC entered fiscal 2027 with stronger cash generation, a net cash position and plans to keep returning free cash flow to shareholders.
